history_caveat: Only 1 daily bundle available (2026-03-10 lifetime). Insufficient for multi-session trend analysis. Conclusions are single-session observations only.

stop_loss.assessment: Largest loss contributor. 47 stop-outs with only 23.4% winning — most stops are actual losses. ATR stops may be too tight or entries are poorly timed.

failure_to_follow.assessment: Second-largest loss contributor. 50 FTF exits at 36% win rate. FTF fires when price fails to follow the predicted direction within the initial window.

trailing_stop.assessment: Only 5 trailing stops but deeply negative avg. 60% of trailing stops resulted in losses, suggesting trailing activates then reverses. Possible ATR trailing distance issue.

max_loss_limit.assessment: 3 catastrophic single-trade losses averaging -$68.72. These are circuit-breaker exits. All losses — investigate which symbols triggered these.

ml_reversal.assessment: POSITIVE CONTRIBUTOR. ML reversal exits are the most profitable exit type — 65% win rate, +$186 total. ML signal appears informative for exit timing even in learning mode.

max_holding_period.assessment: Small but positive. Horizon timeout trades are 80% winners — holding to max period works.

partial_take_profit.assessment: Roughly breakeven despite 71% win rate — winning take-profits are small.

take_profit.assessment: Only 1 full take-profit in 142 trades. Very few trades reach full TP target.

entry_source_contribution.caveat: All 142 trades have empty entry_source field. Cannot attribute PnL to alpha vs breakout entry paths. This is a forensics gap (finding F4).

Q1_lowest.assessment: Worst PnL by far — low-confidence trades are the biggest drag

Q4.assessment: Second worst — high-confidence trades are LOSING more

Q5_highest.assessment: Best win rate but still negative PnL

signal_quality.confidence_assessment: Confidence is NOT correlated with outcome. Q4 (high confidence) has the WORST win rate (32.1%). This suggests the breakout+tension confidence formula is not discriminating well in learning mode.
signal_quality.predicted_return_assessment: All predicted returns are 0.0 — ML is not generating return predictions (learning mode, ml_trained=false in brain). Kelly sizer uses untrained floor.

regime_economics.caveat: regime_at_entry field appears to be populated in live trades but the daily bundle's entry breakdown groups only by entry_source (all 'unknown'). Regime economics require a custom query.

top_3_losers.assessment: Worst performer. 3 trades, all losses. -$103/trade avg. SNOW is a high-vol cloud stock added via .env override (not in code default universe).
Second worst. 6 trades at 33% WR. WMT is defensive/low-vol — momentum strategies may not suit it.
Third worst. 7 trades at 14% WR — nearly all losses.

top_3_winners.assessment: Best performer. 11 trades at 55% WR. Consistent contributor.
Second best. 5 trades at 80% WR. ETF with good momentum capture.
Third best. 6 trades at 50% WR. High volatility works both ways but net positive.

churn_symbols.assessment: Most-traded symbol, net negative. High churn with crypto-correlated volatility.
Second most-traded, net positive. Good candidate.
10 trades at 60% WR but still net negative — winners too small.

top_3_economic_drags: 1. STOP LOSS exits: -$489 (47 trades). Largest single loss source. ATR stops may be too tight or entries are poorly timed against prevailing moves.
2. SNOW/WMT/AVGO symbols: -$711 combined (16 trades). Three symbols account for 75% of total loss. All are .env additions or defensive names not well-suited to momentum.
3. LOW-CONFIDENCE entries (Q1): -$429 from 28 trades. Trades with confidence < 0.31 are consistently money-losing. A higher confidence gate would filter these.
top_3_positive_contributors: 1. ML_REVERSAL exits: +$186 (23 trades, 65% WR). Best exit mechanism — ML signal detects direction changes effectively.
2. AMZN/QQQ/TSLA: +$221 combined (22 trades). Liquid, high-momentum names where the strategy works.
3. MAX_HOLDING_PERIOD exits: +$34 (5 trades, 80% WR). Horizon timeout is working — trades that survive to max hold tend to be winners.
